title: Supreme Court sends Azam Khan's challenge to ED arrest to Allahabad High Court
dek: The Samajwadi Party leader was arrested in a money-laundering case linked to the Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust soon after his release on bail in another case.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
The Supreme Court on Thursday declined to hear Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan's challenge to his arrest by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) and transferred the petition to the Allahabad High Court, one report said.

A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant directed the High Court's registrar to place the matter before its Chief Justice and list it on 16 November. "High Court is requested to pass an appropriate order on the prayer for interim relief on that day," the bench said in its order, as quoted in that report.

Khan was arrested by the ED in a new money-laundering case linked to the Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust shortly after he and his son, Abdullah Azam Khan, walked out of Rampur jail on bail in the dual PAN card case at the end of October; a special court remanded him to judicial custody on 1 November. Arguing for Khan, Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal said the money-laundering law had been wrongly invoked. "They are saying goats, cows are proceeds of crime, how can that be?" he told the court. The ED's arguments were not reported.

Khan, a former Uttar Pradesh minister, faces 92 criminal cases, the Allahabad High Court noted in a separate bail order last week.

sources.title: LawBeat: Supreme Court refuses Azam Khan's plea against ED arrest; transfers petition to Allahabad High Court
